message.content: A mixture-of-experts model is a neural network architecture in which each layer contains many specialized sub-networks, called experts, and a routing mechanism selects only a few experts for each input token. This lets the model have a very large total parameter count while activating only a small fraction per token, increasing capacity without proportionally increasing computation.
